entries.en: Good morning, V. I trust you had a restful night.
entries.ro: Bună dimineața, V. Sper că ați dormit bine.

entries.en: You have one meeting planned today. At the Afterlife. Delamain has confirmed a vehicle arrival at the arranged time.
entries.ro: Aveți o întâlnire programată azi, la Afterlife. Delamain a confirmat sosirea vehiculului la ora convenită.

entries.en: I've noticed your calendar is empty for what remains of the month. Would you like me to begin planning?
entries.ro: Am observat că agenda dumneavoastră e goală până la sfârșitul lunii. Doriți să încep planificarea?
Perfect. Să aveți o zi bună.

entries.en: No, thanks. That's as it should be.
